About this item

  • 【ENERGY SAVING EYE CARE LAMP】- This led book light consumes 80% less energy compared to incandescent lamps. Consists of a long strip shape, stable light source and soft panel housing for a softer light and a wider coverage, which allows you to stay focused and productive while using it. It can be widely used for reading in bed at night, college dorm room, zoom meeting, painting, sewing, nail art, tattoo, makeup, crafts, etc.
  • 【3 LIGHTING MODES & 10 BRIGHTNESS LEVELS】- This dimmable reading light with 23 LED beads offers 3 color modes: warm (3000K), warm and cool (4500K) and cool (6000K). Each lighting mode has 10 brightness dimming levels. Different color temperature and intensity can meet the needs of different scenes.
  • 【FLEXIBLE ARM & STURDY CLIP】- This black desk lights for home office has a 15.8-inch length of 360° flexible arm, allowing you to easily adjust the direction of light, as well as the height and distance. The sturdy clamp can opens up to 2.3-inch, which is very easy to clip on anywhere you want, not only for tables, bed and headboards.
  • 【USB POWERED】 (Plug-in Only, Non-Rechargeable)- This modern reading light comes with a 5V/2A adapter, so you don't need to buy additional adapters. The USB interface is suitable for laptops, desktops, computers, USB docks, mobile power, USB adapters, and many other power supply options. A great gift for kids.
  • 【WHAT YOU'LL GET】: 1x Reading Lamp with Clamp, 1x USB Power Adapter (5V/2A), 1x User Manual, 1x 24-months-warranty.

From the brand

  2. iZell is a relatively young brand, it was founded in 2020, iZell focus on developing consumer electronics products, focusing on user experience and appealing to the concept of environmentalfriendly. We develop products that focus on product longevity and design for a more convenient life.

    iZell have the confidence to provide an industry-leading 3-year product care.

  3. How did we get our start?

    We used to sell a gooseneck book light, which was very popular with consumers. So we magnified the advantages of the book light and made it a desk lamp with more light coverage and more functions. We keep the clamp design for easy to clip on anywhere to use, and saves desk space.

    What makes our products unique?

    We offer two heights of goosenecks from 15.8'' to 27.6'' to meet the needs of multiple scenarios for customers.

    We included a 5V 2A adapter for the USB plug. The best thing about USB plug is that it can be powered by other devices, such as laptop or powerbank!

    Love this light! The color and brightness adjustment is fantastic. It’s super bright and works for doing art in darker environments. It also functions as a great ring light for photos or makeup. I wanted something that wasn’t battery powered because we all know that the battery never lasts; so I love that this is USB. The clamp is super useful and sturdy.       Für mobiles Arbeiten eignet sich die Lampe super.

      Ich bin Mobile Fußpflegerin und sehr zufrieden mit der Lampe in meiner mobilen Arbeit.

      Auf den Bildern habe ich sie an meinen Nageltisch angebracht, für den Anfang reicht sie fürs Nägel machen eventuell aus, für meine Bedürfnisse ist es zum stationären Arbeiten allerdings zu wenig da sie mir persönlich dafür zu klein ist und leider die Fläche daher nicht ausreichend beleuchtet .

      Esta lámpara de escritorio ha sido una maravilla para mi espacio de trabajo y lectura. Tiene 23 LED, lo que proporciona una luz brillante y cómoda para leer o trabajar durante horas sin forzar la vista. Además, tiene 3 colores de luz y 10 niveles de brillo, lo que me permite ajustarla a mi gusto según la actividad. El cuello flexible de cisne es muy práctico para dirigir la luz justo donde la necesito, y su clip me permite colocarla en cualquier parte sin ocupar mucho espacio. 🦢✨

      Pros:

      Ajuste de brillo y color: Los 3 colores y 10 niveles de brillo ofrecen una flexibilidad increíble para adaptarse a cualquier situación.

      Fácil de colocar: La pinza permite sujetarla en escritorios, mesas o estanterías sin que ocupe espacio adicional.

      Flexibilidad total: El cuello de cisne te permite dirigir la luz con precisión donde más la necesites.

      Diseño moderno y elegante: Se ve muy bien en cualquier espacio de trabajo o estudio.

      Bajo consumo: Al ser LED, es eficiente en el consumo de energía, lo que la hace económica a largo plazo. 🔋

      Contras:

      No es muy potente para espacios grandes: Si necesitas iluminar un área más amplia, puede no ser suficiente.

      Cable corto: El cable es un poco corto, por lo que necesitarás una toma de corriente cerca.

      En resumen, esta lámpara LED es perfecta para aquellos que necesitan una fuente de luz ajustable, práctica y eficiente para trabajar o leer. ¡Un imprescindible para mi escritorio! 😎💡

    About this Item

    • 【ENERGY SAVING EYE CARE LAMP】- This led book light consumes 80% less energy compared to incandescent lamps. Consists of a long strip shape, stable light source and soft panel housing for a softer light and a wider coverage, which allows you to stay focused and productive while using it. It can be widely used for reading in bed at night, college dorm room, zoom meeting, painting, sewing, nail art, tattoo, makeup, crafts, etc.
    • 【3 LIGHTING MODES & 10 BRIGHTNESS LEVELS】- This dimmable reading light with 23 LED beads offers 3 color modes: warm (3000K), warm and cool (4500K) and cool (6000K). Each lighting mode has 10 brightness dimming levels. Different color temperature and intensity can meet the needs of different scenes.
    • 【FLEXIBLE ARM & STURDY CLIP】- This black desk lights for home office has a 15.8-inch length of 360° flexible arm, allowing you to easily adjust the direction of light, as well as the height and distance. The sturdy clamp can opens up to 2.3-inch, which is very easy to clip on anywhere you want, not only for tables, bed and headboards.
    • 【USB POWERED】 (Plug-in Only, Non-Rechargeable)- This modern reading light comes with a 5V/2A adapter, so you don't need to buy additional adapters. The USB interface is suitable for laptops, desktops, computers, USB docks, mobile power, USB adapters, and many other power supply options. A great gift for kids.
    • 【WHAT YOU'LL GET】: 1x Reading Lamp with Clamp, 1x USB Power Adapter (5V/2A), 1x User Manual, 1x 24-months-warranty.
